audit_scope.task_scope: cell-state mapping and retrospective RNA-conditioned ATAC

scpair_local.corpus: No upstream checkpoint or pretraining corpus; exact declared outer-training same-cell or same-nucleus RNA-ATAC rows only

released_checkpoint.status: No upstream scPair weights are admitted or required.

interpretation: Local scPair training avoids foundation-checkpoint contamination, but the released high-level workflow is not safe for held RNA-only evaluation. It expects both modality blocks in one object, computes covariate encodings across that object, densifies it, and exposes an augmentation routine that optimizes on unimodal query rows. A direct frozen RNA-encoder/ATAC-decoder adapter can instead produce Bernoulli peak probabilities without observed held ATAC or query fitting. GSE296875 is the only admitted same-nucleus training source; GSE244832 aliquots are never paired. GSE289173 can seal cell-state mapping but has no ATAC endpoint.
remaining_blockers: The current smoke peak inventory was discovered from all source donors, so this view cannot support a champion claim.
An eligible external RNA-ATAC seal is not active.
GSE289173 can support cell-state mapping only and must never be represented as an ATAC seal.
